source_title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic, Anthropic Engineering, published Oct 13, 2026
note: Every number is reported by Anthropic about its own systems. None is an independent benchmark. Drawn counts (mirror icons, dot grids, tiles) are schematic and carry no digits.

numbers.25: Growing our monorepo: 'We perform on the order of 25 million code checkouts per day for CI, before counting developer environments, agent sandboxes, and research jobs.' Shown as 'about 25 million', with 'CI alone · Anthropic's estimate'.
numbers.30,000: Opening: 'as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day.' The merges-per-day figure labels the peak '30,401 merged on Sep 9'. Shown as 'over 30,000 in one day' (a single-day peak, never a rate).
numbers.99: Scaling Scion: 'Each tier of this system maintains a cache hit rate of over 99%'. Always shown as 'over 99%'; the counter is drawn up to 99.
numbers.7: Figure 'Observed performance improvements on native Scion repos', Agent environments, 'New worktree' row: git 7.1 min (median time). Shown as 'about 7 min', labelled median. Archived capture: llm-wiki/raw/assets/anthropic-scion/figure-performance-2x.png.
numbers.5: Same figure and row: scn 5.1 s (median time). Shown as 'about 5 s', labelled median. Only this named operation; the CI checkout rows are 31 s to 3.5 s and 175 s to 22 s. Archived capture: llm-wiki/raw/assets/anthropic-scion/figure-performance-2x.png.
numbers.200: Scaling Scion: 'Our Scion infrastructure footprint is now 200x smaller than our previous git mirroring infrastructure in terms of CPU and memory requirements.' Infrastructure CPU and memory only, not speed or cost.
numbers.20: What we learned building Scion: the Claude Mythos Preview rewrite of the git-to-Scion ingestion pipeline prototype 'consumed 20x less memory'. A prototype pipeline, not Scion itself.
numbers.13: Article date line: 'Published Oct 13, 2026' (source credit tag).
numbers.2026: Article date line: 'Published Oct 13, 2026' (source credit tag).

evidence_incidental.30,401: Raster text inside the merges crop (figure 'Changes merged to our monorepo per day, from January to September 2026'): callout '30,401 merged on Sep 9'. Typed by hand from the 2x capture. Archived capture: llm-wiki/raw/assets/anthropic-scion/figure-merges-2x.png.
evidence_incidental.9: Same callout: 'Sep 9', the day of the 30,401 peak.

claims.l01: Growing our monorepo: on the order of 25 million CI checkouts per day. Headline: 'ANTHROPIC RUNS ABOUT 25 MILLION CI CHECKOUTS A DAY', with the tag 'CI alone · Anthropic's estimate'.
claims.l02: Opening: 'as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day' (merges figure peak: 30,401 merged on Sep 9, the only number shown on screen in this line; 30,000 is in voice and caption). Opening paragraph: 'As our merges per day grew more than tenfold, source control became our biggest development bottleneck.'
claims.l03: Growing our monorepo and Principles: 'we operated several hundred internal git mirrors to deal with the load'; they 'no longer scaled once the repo outgrew the mirrors' disks or memory limits'.
claims.l04: Growing our monorepo and Principles: 'nearly all of our clients were agents and jobs that are online by definition'; Data structures: 'Changesets are created server-side'; the server creates commits, merges and rebases.
claims.l06: Scaling Scion: the client asks only for the trees and blobs it wants; scion-daemon stores objects for the whole node.
claims.l07: Scaling Scion: daemon asks regional scion-cache, which asks scion-server on a miss; 'Every request is for a specific object that never changes, so any cache can answer it.'
claims.l08: Scaling Scion: each tier keeps a cache hit rate of over 99%.
claims.l09: Performance figure, Agent environments, New worktree: git 7.1 min, scn 5.1 s, median time.
claims.l10: Scaling Scion: infrastructure footprint 200x smaller than the previous git mirroring infrastructure in CPU and memory.
claims.l11: What we learned: an early internal snapshot of Claude Mythos Preview rewrote the handwritten git-to-Scion ingestion prototype; the rewrite 'consumed 20x less memory'. On screen: 'early internal Claude model (Claude Mythos Preview)'.
claims.l12: What we learned: 'Agents will sometimes violate core system constraints ... This was particularly common in our migration. For example, there were multiple systems that tried to brute force looking up when a change merged to main by linearly reading the commit log instead of asking our code review tool'; 'Very often, we found that the role of the engineers was to tell Claude no' (we say 'often'). Narration: 'In the migration, Claude sometimes broke core rules. For example, it read the commit log line by line to find when a change merged.' (the validator's wording, split in two for STE).
claims.l13: Contributing to the wider ecosystem: 'Scion is by no means a suitable replacement for git for general use.' Growing our monorepo: 'on the order of 25 million code checkouts per day for CI'.
